query:
WITH price_data AS (
                    SELECT
                        price,
                        created_at,
                        tx_index,
                        log_index,
                        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                            ORDER BY
                                ABS(created_at - $2),
                                tx_index DESC NULLS LAST,
                                log_index DESC
                        ) as closest_to_start,
                        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                            ORDER BY
                                created_at DESC,
                                tx_index DESC NULLS LAST,
                                log_index DESC
                        ) as latest
                    FROM price_history
                    WHERE token_id = $1
                    AND created_at > $2
                    AND created_at <= $3
                )
                SELECT
                    (SELECT price FROM price_data WHERE closest_to_start = 1) as start_price,
                    (SELECT price FROM price_data WHERE latest = 1) as current_price
